reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and a named independent lab with the batch report on the page is exactly what I check before buying. Bisglycinate at a stated 200 mg with no oxide and an empty-box guarantee makes one box an easy risk at the launch price.
objection: Individual foil sachets feel like more packaging waste than a plain bottle, and I want to open the actual lab report and see that the batch number matches before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report linked on the page turned out to be generic or not for the batch, or if the lab were not a real, named lab, I would not buy.
